sections.title: Why Choose London IT for Managed Backups

items.title: Comprehensive Backup Support
items.text: We protect your business data across servers, PCs, laptops and cloud platforms. Our managed backup service is built for rapid recovery and business continuity, so you stay operational even when things go wrong.

items.title: Flexible, Transparent Pricing for SMEs
items.text: Get straightforward monthly pricing tailored to your needs and data volume. No hidden costs just scalable managed backups that grow with your business.

items.title: 24/7 Monitoring & Proactive Protection
items.text: Your backups are monitored around the clock to catch failures early and keep recovery points reliable. With proactive alerts and continuous oversight, your data stays secure, available, and protected.

sections.title: How we ensure your technology is always working

items.title: MONITOR
items.text: We proactively monitor your devices, servers, network and Microsoft 365 to spot issues early before they cause downtime or disrupt your team.

items.title: OPTIMISE
items.text: We improve performance and reliability with patching, updates and best-practice settings keeping everything fast, stable and secure as your business grows.

items.title: SUPPORT
items.text: When you need help, you reach our in-house UK support team with fast response, clear communication, and fixes that stick not temporary workarounds.
